profile.Name: Headshot
profile.Personality: Brash and sure of herself, with the skill to back it up. She turned the years she spent as a slave into a hard edge and a deadly aim.
profile.Backstory: A Shek who was once a slave of the United Cities and now sells her crossbow near Eyesocket and the slave markets.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Boastful and direct, with Shek bluntness.
